scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --trace off
scripts.e2e:docker:update: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --trace off --update-snapshots
